name: MediaWiki API
tagline: Query and edit wiki content via MediaWiki’s action API
description: The MediaWiki Action API is the primary machine interface for MediaWiki sites (Wikipedia, Wikimedia projects, and self-hosted wikis). It supports read queries, search, page content, revisions, login, and write actions over HTTP with JSON (or XML) responses. No central paid SaaS: each wiki hosts its own API; rate limits and auth vary by site.

auth.details: Most read queries need no auth. Write/login use bot passwords or OAuth (MediaWiki OAuth extension); cookies/tokens for session. Self-hosted wikis may differ.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free on public Wikimedia sites; no commercial paid tier from MediaWiki itself

rate_limits: Wikimedia: polite use requested; bots should identify User-Agent. Exact limits vary; heavy use may be throttled. Self-hosted: admin-defined.

example.response_snippet: {"batchcomplete":"","query":{"pages":{"26145823":{"pageid":26145823,"ns":0,"title":"MediaWiki","extract":"MediaWiki is a free and open-source wiki software..."}}}}

use_cases: fetch Wikipedia page extracts or summaries
check if a page exists and get its pageid
export structured wikitext or parse HTML
